status: local design lock before engineering smoke; source workbook not downloaded; source-column mapping pending
source: Shen et al. Nat Methods 2017, doi:10.1038/nmeth.4225, Supplementary Table 2
question: Does the unchanged v31 signed rank-one functional correction improve endpoint-eliminated held-out growth prediction beyond refitted M0 in another study?
readout: per-repeat mean physical-construct control-relative log2 growth slope per day
readout_scope: assayed guide-library mean growth; not fully effective latent gene knockout or author Bayesian whole-map GI score

raw_preprocessing.control_reference: mean log2 count of dual-NTC constructs at each time, cell line and repeat
raw_preprocessing.weights: equal among common qualified physical constructs
forbidden: pooled repeats copied into two channels
guide weights inferred from held-out doubles
raw_preprocessing.threshold_provenance: analyst defaults, not claimed Shen thresholds; verify and log measurement-only amendment before first Shen model fit if original masked raw data require different handling

split.unit: canonical unordered physical gene pair, including all 9 guide constructs and both repeats
split.rule: hash-rank all annotated physical identities before response-dependent QC, assign ceil(20%) to queries; retain assignment after QC without replacement
split.smoke: HeLa only; separate identity-hashed 10% of outer-training pairs as smoke validation; never use formal query outcomes

models.M0: unchanged v31 repeat-specific symmetric endpoint/slope/curvature baseline, ridge=10/supported genes
models.selection: pooled complete-response original-unit SSE on inner folds, explicit zero correction retained; no switch to partner-loss tuning

evaluation.primary: within each cell line, sum partner SSE across both repeats before taking 1-SSE(rank1)/SSE(M0)
evaluation.secondary: full-response loss, repeat-specific losses, additive, spectral
evaluation.cross_cell_summary: unweighted mean of three within-cell-line relative partner gains, alongside all three values; no 2-of-3-sign pass rule
evaluation.projection: query incidence matrix X with ones at two endpoints, P=I-XX+, SVD checked against least squares
evaluation.diagnostics: post-lock cosine and oracle beta only; never rescale frozen predictions with query-derived beta
evaluation.uncertainty: 10000 fixed-prediction endpoint-reweighting draws; conditional sensitivity, not unconditional biological-replicate inference; retain all cell lines/repeats
evaluation.independence: one new source study, three cellular contexts, two biological repeats each; no claim of three independent studies

failure_handling: Record missingness, nonconvergence and unsupported query geometry. Do not tune on formal results, substitute the secondary family, or fabricate two-repeat inputs. Stop source-specific confirmation if source repeat/counterfactual boundary cannot be established.
smoke_scope: Engineering controls and archived Jurkat replay can be run without Shen source data. These never count as Shen empirical replication.
